Hi Olivia / Nick — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we don’t lose momentum.

- Constraints: security team needs audit-log retention and KMS integration; EU product team prefers an afternoon slot for deep technical sessions; APAC engineering (Singapore) can only join early evenings SGT.

Because you have stakeholders across US/EU/APAC, we recommend a short rotating cadence ("demo rings") so the same core session repeats in three time bands over a 3-week rotation. That keeps the invite compact and ensures each region has a convenient slot.

Suggested rotation pattern (high-level):
- Ring A (US-friendly): Tue 10:00–11:00 ET / 14:00–15:00 UTC
- Ring B (EU-friendly): Wed 15:00–16:00 CEST / 13:00–14:00 UTC
- Ring C (APAC-friendly): Thu 19:00–20:00 SGT / 11:00–12:00 UTC

Can you confirm whether that general pattern would work? If yes, please share any absolute blackout windows (e.g., weekly leadership offsites) and who from your side must be included (security, infra, product). If preferred, you can pick slots directly on our Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/60min-technical-deep-dive

Attachments: I attached a short "Rotating demo rings" playbook showing sample calendar invites, a suggested 3-week schedule, and a mutual-action-plan template.

Proposed owners / asks:
- Olivia: confirm mandatory attendees & blackout windows
- Nick: ping on security evidence you want surfaced during the session (SOC2 scope, encryption/TLS specifics)
- Marissa / Priyom (cc): we’ll draft the MAP and calendar invites once Olivia confirms.

Thanks — happy to adapt cadence if Skylark prefers a different pattern.

Cheers,
